value.name: Marylin answers the door
value.description: Marylin walks to the door and opens it to find two police officers outside.
evidence: Marylin walks to the door. Opens it. Two POLICE OFFICERS.

value.name: Marylin greets officers
value.description: Marylin asks the officers if she can help them.
evidence: MARYLIN Yes? Can I help you?

value.name: officer identifies Marylin
value.description: One officer confirms Marylin's full name, signaling an official confrontation.
evidence: POLICE OFFICER Marylin Hamilton Rexroth Doyle Massey?

value.name: officers announce arrest warrant
value.description: The police inform Marylin that they have a warrant for her arrest.
evidence: POLICE OFFICER We have a warrant for your arrest.

value.name: Marylin reacts in shock
value.description: Marylin responds with stunned disbelief at the arrest warrant.
